title: Large language model-based biological age prediction in large-scale populations

evidence_spans.quote: Our results showed that the LLM-predicted overall age achieved a concordance index
six population-based cohorts, encompassing over 10 million participants
identify proteomic biomarkers associated with accelerated aging

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: Original population-cohort analysis of biological aging. It reports proteomic biomarkers, while epigenetic ages are comparator proxies rather than analyzed underlying epigenomic data; no current multi-omics analysis is claimed.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: LLM-predicted overall and organ-specific age gaps
causal_design_reviewer.comparator: telomere length, frailty index, eight epigenetic ages and four machine-learning models predictions
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: C-index of 0.757 for all-cause mortality; hazard ratio of 1.055 for overall age gap and all-cause mortality

evidence_spans.quote: We validated this approach across six population-based cohorts
develop risk prediction models of 270 diseases

causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The report presents completed cohort validation and prediction analyses, but states no qualifying intervention, perturbation, instrumental-variable, mediation, quasi-experimental, or explicit causal/structural design.

directional_result_reviewer.concise_rationale: The abstract reports prediction performance and associations, without a matching current-report directional X-to-Y result.
